name: Ishida Mitsunari
source:
"Don't talk to me, do you want to be killed?"

Ishida Mitsunari serves Hideyoshi blindly. He is the most expatriate of all, fiercely intelligent and venom-tongued but he is slow of speech and inflexible. What is his sad secret?

Temperament: Rationalism
Likes: Manjuu
